responsibility: This is the main hand-written implementation file for the PRU target backend, defining most target hooks and runtime code-generation policy that complements pru.md and pru.h. It owns PRU machine-function state and frame-layout computation, prologue/epilogue and register-save logic, calling convention and return-in-memory decisions, address legitimacy and operand/assembly printing helpers, target option reinitialization per function, built-in declaration and expansion such as __delay_cycles, halt, and LMBD, machine-dependent RTL reorganization including doloop handling, libfunc setup, and other core targetm hook implementations that turn GCC RTL and trees into PRU-specific code-generation behavior.
same_name_distinction: Hand-written implementation member of the pru.* group: unlike pru.h, which provides target macros and static configuration, pru.md, which declaratively defines PRU RTL instruction patterns, and pru.opt, which declares PRU command-line options, this file contains the executable backend logic that implements target hooks and lowers/adjusts those interfaces at compile time, including builtin expansion, frame/prologue handling, per-function target reinit, and machine-dependent reorg such as doloop processing.
